title: OPSPAWN
description: Best spawn plugin with full Folia support.
body:
# Plugin Features Overview
**Teleport to Spawn from Anywhere:**
Players can use the /spawn command to instantly teleport to the server's spawn location, no matter where they are on the map.

**Set Server Spawn Point:**
Moderators must set the server spawn location in advance using the /setspawn command.

**Customizable Messages and Timer:**
Easily edit teleportation messages and the timer duration in the config.yml file to fit your server’s preferences.

**HEX Color Code Support:**
All messages support HEX color codes, allowing for vibrant and personalized server messages.

**Easy Plugin Reload:**
Apply changes made in the config.yml instantly using the /spawnreload command—no need to reload or restart the server
